design: Discovery-only utility targets. Deduplicate132old training prompts,8noun discovery endpoints,768natural discovery states. Fixed multi-anchor dictionary and mean. Exactly32active coordinates: scalarTop32 or one forced anchor group plus remaining highest-energy coordinates. Seven real groups, two atom-permuted panels preserving sizes/overlap. Identity and dense128 references.
selection: Per-state lowest native-outputKL among scalar and seven panel choices is an in-sample oracle; it uses the native downstream output and is not a deployable encoder. All candidates saved for future training. No evaluation/confirmation states used.
metric: KL(native || candidate). No paired-edit optimization in this target collection; whole-state and paired validation required for later learned router.
limits: Only8nounstates, repeated task vocabulary,192natural training documents. Oracle includes scalar and therefore cannot be worse by construction; compare gain size against equal-choice shuffled panels. Group-plus-fill is hybrid sparsity, not pure group sparsity. No neural gate trained.
